name: Rochester

neighborhoods.name: South Wedge
neighborhoods.homes: older houses and small apartment buildings

housing: Rochester's rentals are mostly older single-family and two-family houses, many built before 1950, and apartments in converted houses.

localRules.text: Rochester requires most rental properties to have a city certificate of occupancy, which also serves as the lead safety certificate for older homes.

tenantHelp.name: Tenant Defense Project
tenantHelp.what: free legal advice and representation for tenants facing eviction

tenantHelp.name: Legal Assistance of Western New York
tenantHelp.what: free civil legal help for low-income renters

climate: Test the heat, check windows for drafts and peeling paint, and ask who clears snow; lake-effect snow makes winters long.
fact: Because most Rochester homes are old, the city checks rentals for lead hazards, so ask to see the certificate of occupancy.
